review.summary: Proposal is a self-contained o11 controls rewrite that materially addresses the packet’s four NEEDS_CORRECTION items (renumbered-q probe, non-crashing witness scan, per-candidate charge.take, checker identity + profile/rows probes), but still overclaims semantic discrimination, weakens structural rejection scoring, and only partially covers the wave04 changed-Q/moved-position family—repair before lead review.
